title: mission
description: C6 science mission read by the HUD and converted to C4 routing inputs. Coordinates are east and north in metres relative to the zone ENU origin.

base_enu_m.description: Return base in metres. When omitted, the HUD uses habitat_enu_m from the active zone.json. Explicit null is not an omitted base.

stops.description: Science stops in input order. Unique stop ids and positions inside the active walkable zone require semantic validation by the consumer.

t_s.description: Available mission duration in seconds, including science stops and return.

dose_uGy.description: Absorbed-dose budget in microgray. The shared synthetic fixture uses the design value of 50; this is not a NASA exposure limit.

dwell_s.description: Science time spent at the stop in seconds.
